total_input_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the prompt (context).

total_output_tokens.description: Total number of tokens across all the generated responses.

total_thought_tokens.description: Number of tokens of thoughts for thinking models.

total_tokens.description:
Total token count for the interaction request (prompt + responses + other internal
tokens).

total_tool_use_tokens.description: Number of tokens present in tool-use prompt(s).

content.description: The content blocks that make up the user input.

VerbatimTranscriptionMode.description: Additional options for verbatim transcription mode.

timestamp_granularities.description:
The granularity of timestamps to include in the transcription output. Supported values:
`"word\"` If empty, no timestamps are generated.

VideoAspectRatio.description: The aspect ratio for a video output.

task.description:
The task mode for the generation. Left unset, the model determines the mode from the
prompt and the input media.

mime_type.description: The mime type of the video.

name.description:
A user-defined name for this content block, which the model can reference in its final
response.

processing.description: How the model processes this video for understanding.

mime_type.description: The mime type of the video.

VideoDeltaMimeType.description: The mime type of a video block.

VideoMimeType.description: The mime type of a video block.

VideoProcessing.description:
How the model processes a video for understanding.

The API accepts either a bare [`VideoProcessingMode`] or a [`MediaProcessing`] configuration.

oneOf.description: A processing mode, taking the defaults of that mode.

VideoProcessingMode.description: A way the model processes a video for understanding.

VideoResolution.description: The resolution for a video output.

aspect_ratio.description: The aspect ratio for the video output.

delivery.description: The delivery mode for the video output.

duration.description: The duration for the video output.

resolution.description: The video output resolution. Defaults to 720p.

VideoTask.description: The task mode for video generation.

WebhookConfig.description: Where to deliver notifications about an interaction.

uris.description: The webhook URIs to use for this interaction, in place of the registered webhooks.

WordInfo.description: Word-level timing and speaker information for a transcribed audio segment.

end_index.description: End of the attributed segment, exclusive.

end_offset.description:
End offset in time of the word relative to the start of the audio.

Present when `timestamp_granularities` contains `"word"`.

speaker.description:
Speaker label for this word (e.g. `"spk_1"`, `"spk_2"`).

Present when `diarization_mode` is set in `TranscriptionConfig`.

start_index.description: Start of segment of the response that is attributed to this source, in bytes.

start_offset.description:
Start offset in time of the word relative to the start of the audio.

Present when `timestamp_granularities` contains `"word"`.

googleGenAIAuth.description: An OAuth access token sent as a bearer `Authorization` header, or a Gemini API key sent as `x-goog-api-key`.
